contracts.name: PublicationBundle
contracts.subject: Bind workspace, original operation, precondition HEAD, expected selector, registry/index/source postimages and exact target set.
contracts.invariant: Require separate native permission and canonical authorization for the closed bundle. Historic receipt recovery checks the original operation, expected selector and observed postimage.

contracts.name: CompatibilityAssessment
contracts.subject: Bind identity, carrier, schema, generator, source and target original bytes and complete relation edges.
contracts.invariant: Retained reads preserve exact bytes. Upgrades require reviewed bijective edge mapping or a separately reviewed meaning change. Digest the selected formal voice, boundaries and scope with a versioned canonical serializer.

normative_digest.encoding: UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted object keys, original array order, Unicode preserved, no whitespace or trailing LF, finite JSON values only
normative_digest.relations: Separate complete exact edge manifest including kind, target identity, source binding and annotations. Every edge must be preserved or mapped once to a reviewed exact target edge.

contracts.name: LifecycleTransition
contracts.subject: Bind current body, successor or explicit absence, lifecycle intent, operation, scope and consumer closure.
contracts.invariant: Closure declares the consumer universe, cut and traversal evidence. Unknown consumers, missing cursors or truncation block effects. Permission and owner review refer to the same proposal.

contracts.name: JoinTransition
contracts.subject: Bind stable run, revision, signal, previous phase and observed original operation outcome.
contracts.invariant: Terminal phases preserve history. Unknown outcomes reconcile before retry. Proven refusal resolves both unknown phases. Persist past facts and phase together under revision CAS.

phase_rules.Completed: Preserve a verified terminal journal receipt with consistent committed/replayed native and publication outcomes. Contradictions require inspection.
phase_rules.Refused: Preserve a verified terminal refusal with consistent effect outcomes. A committed publication cannot be erased by refusal.
phase_rules.NativeUnknown: Inspect original native operation. Record commit or proven refusal only.
phase_rules.PublicationUnknown: Inspect original selector operation. Record publication or proven refusal only.
phase_rules.CanonicalPublished: Use the exact historical snapshot and publication receipt before handling current-cut drift.
phase_rules.LocalCommitted: Prepare publication only for confirmed inert local custody
phase_rules.PublicationPrepared: Prepare canonical publication; direct proven refusal is recordable. Unknown enters PublicationUnknown and requires original-operation inspection.

contracts.name: ConstructionEvidence
contracts.subject: Bind complete selected subjects, six handoffs, executable specs, executor and fixture per obligation.
contracts.invariant: Completion consumes a verified entry receipt and exact output, with one independent result per required spec. Preserve inherited compatibility.

contracts.name: AdmissionBoundary
contracts.subject: Stage immutable registry, index, source and receipt consequences of the reviewed Decision Bundle.
contracts.invariant: Native draft persistence is inert. Authority becomes visible through a single compare-and-swap on the qualified snapshot selector. All authoritative readers resolve via that selector. Refuse cutover with legacy readers still active. Native authority-changing transactions require their own complete atomic boundary and cannot be partially exposed.

contracts.name: OutcomePolicy
contracts.subject: Choose review and native continuations as ordered policies.
contracts.invariant: Calculations construct results. Deterministic entry reference translation stays a Mapping.

contracts.name: JoinIdentity
contracts.subject: Use unique workspace/run identity plus unique original operation correlation.
contracts.invariant: Derive storage key from the identity through a verified mapping. Persist identity and command tuple atomically. Replays return the original receipt. Different tuples conflict. Historical recovery reads by original identity across cuts.

contracts.name: VerificationPorts
contracts.subject: Every port returns a typed verified proposition or explicit Refused, Stale, Missing, Unknown or Conflict.
contracts.invariant: Validate registry carry-forward, unique identities, lookup targets, schema/generator pairing and projections before generating the closed publication bundle.

checks: Reconstruct retained version set and selected lookup from predecessor.
Verify unique exact version keys and match every body binding against its selected original bytes.
Allow a changed standing or new identity only through an explicit authorized delta.
Verify descriptor, schema, generator, carrier admission and disposition per entry.
Reproduce projection and index from original bodies and verified lookup.
Bind assessed predecessor and postimage with every applicable selection to the returned receipt.
registry_validator.v1: Reuse the embedded Registry/v1 contract and canonical predecessor.
registry_validator.v2: Reuse proposed Registry/v2 schema. Contract admission and reader adoption require separate review.

contracts.name: SelectionCoverage
contracts.subject: Bind the complete 46-target selection, including the two pending targets outside the binding list.
contracts.invariant: Carry all selected exact target bindings under a 64-binding limit. Partition into verified admitted historical meanings and at most 24 pending exact reviews. Check the union and disjointness. Reject an over-bound or incomplete manifest.
